title: Live Supabase mode enabled
notes: 1.4.3: the store switches from localStorage demo mode to live Supabase (project obneyqnrnmnaqqshuzuo). config.js now carries the project URL and the sb_publishable_... key, both of which are public by design and safe in the browser; no service_role key or database password is present in the repo, and DEMO now evaluates false. The schema is applied: 17 tables with RLS enabled on all of them, 46 public policies plus 2 on storage.objects, 5 functions, 6 seeded products and 41 design options. Verified over the REST API with the publishable key that the private tables (profiles, orders, addresses, wallet_txn, contact_messages) all return zero rows to an anonymous caller while the public catalog reads normally. Schema apply blockers fixed and committed separately: reviews.user was renamed to user_name because 'user' is reserved in Postgres and the batch failed with 42601; is_admin() is now a zero-argument SECURITY DEFINER helper defined after the tables, since a LANGUAGE sql body is validated at CREATE time and an INVOKER body re-entered the profiles policies and raised 42P17 infinite recursion; restock_order is now admin-only and restricted to cancelled orders; the design_options seed got a unique index on (group_name, value) so re-running the file no longer duplicates rows; reviews are now read from the live table in the admin panel instead of localStorage only. The harness build blanks the two Supabase variables in its own copy of config.js so the suites keep exercising demo behaviour; tokens ?v=7, service worker cache aq-v7

1.4.2: admin portal CRUD completed and saved addresses added - FAQs gain full add/edit/delete plus ordering (there was previously no FAQ admin UI at all); the journal admin panel, which only toasted 'seeded in demo mode', now does real add/edit/delete with title, excerpt, body and publish date; gallery gains add/delete and a sort field; reviews gain permanent delete alongside approve/hide; the inbox gains delete and a mailto reply link. Customer management replaces a broken 'Make admin' button (a no-op that mutated a throwaway array) with a working per-row role selector and loyalty-points editor. Fixes: Supabase writes no longer send client-side string ids into uuid primary-key columns for products, design options, reviews or contact messages (these would have failed on live), and demo mode now honours the admin sort/published fields. The previously-unused 'addresses' table is now wired up: DB.addressList/addressSave/addressDelete plus a Saved addresses panel on the account page (add, list, make default, delete, scoped per user). New harness probes: admin_crud.js (34 checks) and addresses.js (12 checks); smoke 0/80 and flow 0/6 still pass; tokens ?v=6, service worker cache aq-v6

1.4.1: bag designer (configurator) restored to the stylised CSS-drawn preview - the real-photo preview attempt (v1.5.0) was reverted because the assembled images/variables rendered inconsistently; the designer now returns to the reliable inline preview with live colour/hardware/handle swatches, keeping all v1.4.0 content, business defaults and contact details intact; tokens ?v=5, service worker cache aq-v5

1.4.0: full site content refresh - home, shop, about, custom orders, corporate & wholesale, shipping & returns, FAQ, contact and journal pages rewritten to the approved content brief ('Crowned in craft. Carried with purpose.'), using chosen business defaults (2-4 week custom turnaround, 20-unit bulk minimum, 50% deposit, The Courier Guy, free delivery over R1,500, 7-day returns, Sandton pickup by appointment, Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00 / Sat 09:00-13:00); contact details centralised in config.js AQ.CONTACT for easy editing; new pages custom.html, corporate.html and shipping-returns.html; nav + footer + sitemap + service worker updated; tokens ?v=5, service worker cache aq-v5

1.3.0: official company logo artwork adopted - new brand mark in the site header (assets/logo.png), custom favicon (assets/icons/favicon.png) and PWA icons regenerated from the logo; social-share (og:image / twitter:image) paths fixed to the maskable icon; tokens bumped to ?v=4, service worker cache aq-v4

1.2.0: selling the in-house collection with real inventory - stock is decremented on every purchase and restored on refunds (Supabase sell_stock / restock_order RPCs, demo localStorage counter), low-stock 'Only X left' and sold-out states across shop, product detail, bag and checkout; add-to-bag and checkout refuse overselling; admin products screen gains quick +5/+10/+20 restock and low-stock warnings; e-commerce probe automates buy/refund/restock flows
